svg.title: Corrected LangGraph interview flow
svg.desc: Corrected flow: section_router picks section once, section node asks question, submit receives answer, per_question_evaluator scores and stores, then routes back to section_router only if section is complete, else asks next Q in same section.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the start node initialise?')
sendPrompt('When exactly is section_router called and what does it decide?')
sendPrompt('What does the communication node do?')
sendPrompt('What does the technical node do?')
sendPrompt('What does the project node do?')
sendPrompt('What does per_question_evaluator store in memory?')
sendPrompt('What does final_evaluation do with all scores from memory?')

svg.text: → go back to the SAME section node (comm / tech / proj)
→ section done, call section_router to pick next section
→ all 9 Qs done, go to final_evaluation
→ user quit early, go to final_evaluation
section_router is called ONLY at start and when switching sections (every 3 Qs)
